content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Overland Park

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's dual-track eligibility criteria: bachelor's degree holders need three years of documented PM experience; those without a degree need five years. Gather your project records now to support your application.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course—designed for working professionals in Overland Park and nationwide. Attend interactive sessions on your schedule, ask questions in real time, and receive the official contact-hour certificate required by PMI upon completion.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account, complete the credential application, and upload proof of your education, experience, and training hours. Submit your application fee to PMI and await approval—typically within days. Once approved, you'll receive authorization to schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor Q&A sessions—to reinforce PMBOK® knowledge and exam strategy. Register with Pearson VUE, select your testing center or online proctor option, and take the four-hour, 180-question examination.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP®, commit to the three-year renewal cycle by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, conferences, volunteer work, or publishing. Submit your renewal fee and PDU documentation to PMI before your credential expires to stay current.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
